column1: # Firstmate toolchain manifest: the certified version of each agent runtime,
# why that version is the pin, and where its certification evidence lives.
# Read by fm_toolchain_check (bin/fm-toolchain-lib.sh), which compares each row
# against PATH reality at session start and prints one TOOLCHAIN_DRIFT: line per
# mismatch. That header owns the comparison and the fail-open contract; this
# file owns only the rows.
# Tab-separated, five columns, one runtime per row:
#   runtime
# runtime    manifest key, and the name shown in the diagnostic line.
# command    the PATH binary probed with --version.
# certified  the newest version this repo carries certification evidence for.
# why        one line on what that pin buys, for the reader deciding what to do.
# evidence   tracked path holding the certification record.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. No column may contain a tab.
# RULE: certified is transcribed from tracked evidence, never guessed, and a
# runtime is listed only once its --version output has been parsed on a real
# machine. Recording a version nobody verified would rebuild the exact blindness
# this manifest exists to remove. A dated re-verification of one behavior on a
# newer build is not a certification and does not move this column; only a
# certification record in the evidence path does.
# Deliberately absent, pending a machine that has it installed:
#   grok - certified 0.2.103 (docs/watcher-continuity.md), not installed here.
#          The x.ai installer left a truncated 59170816-byte download under
#          ~/.grok/downloads and an empty ~/.grok/bin, so no binary runs and no
#          --version output could be parsed on this machine.
# Add the row after verifying its probe output on a machine that has it.
# This machine does have an opencode platform binary, contrary to the note that
# stood here before: the global install is unusable only because its postinstall
# never ran, which is a wiring defect and not a missing build.
# The opencode row's certified version is transcribed from
# docs/watcher-continuity.md.
# runtime
claude
